judgments.reason: The paper's title and abstract explicitly introduce and describe the 'new open access database of electroencephalogram (EEG) signals recorded while 15 subjects imagined the pronunciation of two groups of Spanish words.'
judgments.paper_title: Open access database of EEG signals recorded during imagined speech
judgments.paper_venue: Proceedings of SPIE, the International Society for Optical Engineering/Proceedings of SPIE

judgments.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a software tool and specification for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, which is a technical resource used for data handling.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: The paper introduces EEG-BIDS, an extension to the BIDS standard for EEG data, which is a technical specification/tool used for organizing data, not a paper describing the content of this specific dataset.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
